request.goal: Make safeWindowsFileName handle every reserved Windows device name, including numbered COM and LPT forms, and observe on Windows that the replacement name can actually be created.

plan.summary: Expand safeWindowsFileName to rewrite every reserved Windows device name, including numbered and superscript COM/LPT forms, and implement the existing Windows create observation.
plan.overview: Update src/platform.ts so reserved device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, and COM/LPT superscript 1–3) are prefixed with an underscore. Keep the existing replacement style. Implement src/platform.test.ts case "creates the replacement on Windows" so it actually creates the replacement file on win32; leave skipIf for non-Windows. Linux can prove mapping and suite exit; Windows filesystem create remains extra evidence.

features.title: Cover all reserved Windows device names
features.summary: safeWindowsFileName rewrites CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, numbered COM/LPT (0–9), and superscript COM/LPT¹–³ so the replacement is not a reserved device name; the existing "creates the replacement on Windows" case observes that the replacement can be created as a real file.
validation: safeWindowsFileName maps CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, and COM/LPT¹–³ to a prefixed non-reserved name and leaves ordinary names unchanged
creates the replacement on Windows creates the replacement as a real file on win32

requirements: Rewrite every reserved Windows device name: CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, and superscript COM¹/COM²/COM³ and LPT¹/LPT²/LPT³
Numbered COM and LPT forms must be handled, not only CON/PRN/AUX/NUL
Preserve underscore-prefix replacement for reserved names; leave non-reserved names unchanged
Acceptance requires observing on Windows that the replacement name can actually be created
Keep and implement the existing test case name "creates the replacement on Windows" in src/platform.test.ts
Do not replace that named Windows case with an unnamed local check
Non-goal: sanitizing invalid filename characters, trailing dots/spaces, or reserved names with extensions (e.g. CON.txt)
decisions: Treat Microsoft's current reserved device set as CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0–COM9, LPT0–LPT9, plus superscript COM/LPT 1–3
Keep existing `_` prefix behavior rather than substituting a different token
The Windows create test stays skipIf(process.platform !== "win32") so Linux does not fake filesystem proof
Linux gate proves suite exit and mapping tests; named Windows create case is extra evidence on win32

evidence.requirement: Replacement name can actually be created on Windows
